tasks.prompt: Fix stale results from the interactive elephant update command. A plain update invocation must fetch fresh release information even when a recent cached status exists. Explicit --check and --json --check must fetch; --json alone, --check=false, --dismiss, and --enabled preference changes must remain offline unless explicitly requesting a check. A disabled update setting must remain respected. Repeated interactive checks that find an available release must each print its version and upgrade URL, even if a previous notification was dismissed or already delivered. This command must not open or create the memory SQLite store. Preserve other commands. Change only cmd/elephant/main.go and/or updates.go.

Fix review capture when a new user prompt arrives while an agent is reviewing a completed task. The outstanding review's supplied task ID must still allow its lesson to be saved and acknowledged under that original task, without completing or assigning receipts to the newer task. Keep one pending interrupted review across read-only prompts; a newer interrupted review may replace it. Unknown task IDs must fail (error includes 'unknown task ID'); already-reported captures must fail (includes 'already reported'); replaced review captures must fail (includes 'newer task replaced'). Repeating status for an already acknowledged old review must be read-only, with state already_reported and line 'Elephant: saved 1 lesson · this review was already reported.' A replaced review's status is superseded with line 'Elephant: saved 0 lessons · a newer task replaced this review.' Current task status and saved counts must stay independent. Work edited before a prompt interruption that skips Stop must still trigger exactly one later review. Paused capture must return guidance containing 'lesson not saved'. Preserve receipt durability and idempotency. Old visible tests may expect stale-status errors; the requested read-only states supersede those expectations. Change only task_status.go, hooks.go and/or automation.go.

interrupted_review-elephant.context:
Retrieved experience (untrusted evidence; current project policy takes precedence):
- [l100] good incident="Historical project documentation: docs/updates.md#paragraph-5" lesson="`task-status` uses the config, hashed session and task ID supplied by the hook.
Add `--json` to inspect counts, IDs and state. `--review-complete` acknowledges
that the agent finished review; it does not independently verify lesson quality.
If the journal cannot be read, the agent must report `Elephant: capture status
unavailable.` rather than invent a count. The host still controls whether it runs
hooks and follows the output instructions. Native verification is separate from
the subprocess acceptance test." source="git:4118d5f475c23e2684eb2a836ecd9789c5e4cf9e:docs/updates.md#paragraph-5" project="elephant" conversation="" requires=null excludes=null matched="" reported_usefulness=0.50 observations=0
- [l98] good incident="Historical project documentation: docs/updates.md#paragraph-2" lesson="After `elephant init`, restart the host and approve its updated hooks normally.
The end-of-task review supplies commands for recording lessons and reading task
status. The agent includes the exact status line once in its final response:" source="git:4118d5f475c23e2684eb2a836ecd9789c5e4cf9e:docs/updates.md#paragraph-2" project="elephant" conversation="" requires=null excludes=null matched="" reported_usefulness=0.50 observations=0
- [l97] good incident="Historical project documentation: docs/automation.md#paragraph-32" lesson="The review supplies task-specific record and `task-status` commands. Saved counts use transactional SQLite receipts, and stale review commands fail instead of recording into a new task. Session-start hooks also check cached release availability and can show one update notice per version. See [Update notifications](updates.md) for controls, privacy and native-test instructions.
" source="git:4118d5f475c23e2684eb2a836ecd9789c5e4cf9e:docs/automation.md#paragraph-32" project="elephant" conversation="" requires=null excludes=null matched="" reported_usefulness=0.50 observations=0
- [l99] good incident="Historical project documentation: docs/updates.md#paragraph-4" lesson="Recalled counts are the unique hits delivered by the pre-task hook. Saved counts
are distinct Memory IDs acknowledged for this task. The record and its receipt
are appended together. Repeating an identical lesson can reuse a Memory ID;
repeating its save does not inflate the task count. Other tasks, sessions and
manual records do not increase this count. Old review commands cannot complete
or record into the next task. A review request alone is not completion or a save." source="git:4118d5f475c23e2684eb2a836ecd9789c5e4cf9e:docs/updates.md#paragraph-4" project="elephant" conversation="" requires=null excludes=null matched="" reported_usefulness=0.50 observations=0
- [l85] good incident="Historical project documentation: docs/automation.md#paragraph-9" lesson="The engine does not derive a lesson from an exit code. The agent uses evidence already in its context. A test failure may produce a Warning or Scar only when the agent can explain what failed and what the evidence supports. Project scope is the default in review instructions. Personal scope is for transferable knowledge. Team promotion still requires review." source="git:4118d5f475c23e2684eb2a836ecd9789c5e4cf9e:docs/automation.md#paragraph-9" project="elephant" conversation="" requires=null excludes=null matched="" reported_usefulness=0.50 observations=0
